method: Full txids and runestone fields (name, spacers, symbol, divisibility, premine, mint terms) come from mempool.space block 840000 tx data (block hash 0000000000000000000320283a032748cef8227873ff4872689bf23f1cda83a5), decoded locally from the OP_RETURN runestone; numbers/supply as shown come from ordiscan pages where noted. Every txid was fetched individually from mempool.space or checked via /txid/N; ordiscan truncated txid prefix and suffix match for all ordiscan-confirmed runes.

runes.name: UNCOMMON•GOODS
runes.notes: Genesis rune: no etching transaction (txid null). Rune ID 1:0 shown as contract on CoinGecko page. Symbol, supply, block and number NOT confirmed from any fetched page (ordiscan page failed 4+ times; docs only list the glyph as a generic example). CoinGecko shows circulating supply 171.149M, which is a market-data figure not a protocol figure.
